svg.aria-label: One frame from the robot's camera at 3:03 PM, cropped below the windows: gray carpet, the ball in front and the two pale yellow cones behind it. The cone color range set from the organizers' photos, saturation 200 and up, marks nothing in the frame. A range refit on this same recording, saturation 65 and up, marks both cones.
